# Ba Studio

> AI podcast production studio. From a guest's name to a finished, on-brand
> episode in minutes, in one place that learns how you sound.

Ba Studio turns the whole podcast workflow into a single guided flow: research a
guest, shape the episode, generate a script and show notes in your voice, and
prep everything for recording and publishing. The studio learns each show's
"DNA" (tone, format, recurring segments) so output stays on-brand over time.

## What it does

- Guest research: go from a guest's name to a briefing and tailored questions.
- Episode building: a step-by-step wizard from idea to ready-to-record outline.
- Podcast DNA: capture a show's voice and format so AI output stays consistent.
- Script, show notes, and titles generated in the host's voice.
- Multi-language output (including Hebrew with full right-to-left support).
- Team workflows: shows, episodes, calendar, guests, and review in one place.

## Who it is for

Podcast hosts, producers, and small media teams who want to produce more
episodes without losing their voice or spending hours on prep and post.

## Pricing

- Free: $0. Get started and produce your first episodes.
- Studio Solo: $19.99 / month. For individual creators producing regularly.
- Master: $29.99 / month. For power users and small teams.

Annual billing is available on the paid plans.
